clean.text: Okay, so the problem with the drawer is that when you refresh the page with the query string drawer=AI open, then you close the drawer, the main column stays fixed and so the drawer closing doesn't return the space to the main page.
It doesn't happen if you refresh the page: then the hamburger menu goes back to the far right corner, the space is returned, and when we open it the main column squeezes down, seems to be resizable.
But when we close the — well, that time it actually did work; I'm not sure why, trying to reproduce this reliably.
So if I refresh the page and close the drawer, the query string disappears but the main column doesn't resize.

If I resize the two columns with the resizer and then close it — oh yeah, it still does, so it closes properly but it doesn't return — it doesn't fix the size so that the main area fills the width again.

bullets.text: The problem: when you refresh the page with the drawer=AI query string open, then close the drawer, the main column stays fixed — the space doesn't return to the main page
bullets.label: S1

bullets.text: It works fine if you just open and close the drawer without a refresh: the hamburger menu goes back to the far right, the space returns, and the main column squeezes down and stays resizable
bullets.label: S2

bullets.text: The bug is unreliable — sometimes the close does work, but it's hard to reproduce consistently
bullets.label: S3

bullets.text: The specific trigger: refresh the page, close the drawer — the query string disappears but the main column doesn't resize
bullets.label: S4

bullets.text: Using the resizer between the columns and then closing the drawer also doesn't fix it — it closes properly but doesn't return the space so the main area fills the width again
bullets.label: S5
